payload.short: Form 4-H threshold: Arabic 10% governs vs English 25%
payload.text: The Arabic and English versions of Form 4-H disagree on the beneficial-ownership threshold. The governing Arabic (Appendix A, decl1) says ten per cent (١٠٪ / 10%); the English (p.5) says twenty-five per cent (25%). 8.2 makes the Arabic govern, so each member must disclose every natural person holding 10% or more of its capital or voting rights. Preparing to the English 25% risks an incomplete Form 4-H, which is non-responsive under 8.4. Consider a clarification to the Authority; meanwhile prepare to 10%.
